experience.job_title: Senior Vice President, Strategy & Platform Development
experience.description:
• Domain: Capital markets and financial services platform for businesses, investors, and lenders
• Built and scaled a nationwide ecosystem of 2,000+ retired banking professionals, converting 200+ members into active paid participants through platform-led community management and a structured monetization framework.
• Led API integrations with BimaKavach (insurance), eFundzz (fintech), Probe42 (business intelligence), and DhanLap (LAMF & LAS products); integrated cross-sell portfolio to expand platform financial services offering.
• Established strategic partnerships with investment banking firms and fund houses to expand platform transaction execution capabilities and offer clients access to a broader capital market network.
• Evaluated 200+ investment opportunities and executed INR 10-200 Cr financing transactions spanning structured credit, pre- IPO placements, refinancing, project completion funding, and invoice discounting.
• Developed financial models, valuation frameworks, IRR scenarios, investment memos, and collateral schedules for institutional investors, lenders, and credit committees across all executed transactions.

• Domain: Leading finance transformation initiatives, financial planning & budgeting for India GCC office
• Owned annual budgeting (~USD 200M) and rolling forecasts for 2,000+ employees, delivering under 2% variance; led a 5- member analyst team on management reporting, variance analysis, KPI tracking, and quarter-close activities.
• Built automated financial planning tools and Power BI dashboards reducing manual effort by 400+ hours annually; developed competitor intelligence and benchmarking models supporting strategic planning for global leadership.
• Built multi-year financial models and scenario frameworks for cost driver analysis, capacity planning, and macro sensitivities; served as FP&A-to-accounting liaison for accruals, actuals, and month-end close alignment.
• Build compensation planning automation tool collaborating with product & engineering teams, to model compensation for 2000+ employees based at India offices.
• Developed forecast model for headcount, P&L and other key indicators, developed budget pack for Board approvals.

• Domain: Led FP&A, corporate development, and enterprise performance for India operations
• Supported the Aon-Catamaran M&A transaction end-to-end for name change & shareholding transfer from Anviti to Aon India.
• Developed valuation model, 5 years forecasts, strategy deck, diligence coordination, and legal advisor liaison.
• Reduced accounts receivables by 80% liasoning with all department heads & external insurance companies through data intelligence, dashboarding, strategic initiatives & reconciliations.
• Led FP&A, board-level MIS reporting, and TM1 planning system implementation; developed Power BI dashboards for KPI tracking; presented performance insights and strategic recommendations to CEO, CFO, and global leadership.

• Domain: Strategic advisor to the Global CEO
• Shaped board presentations, investor communications, and enterprise growth strategy; led international business analytics on market sizing, pricing, and portfolio profitability; supported M&A pipeline and new business evaluation.
• Led RISE project implementation & steering innovation pipeline to reduce Go to market time from 12 months to <3 months.
• Analyzed Nielson intelligence reports to study competition & market share to provide strategic interventions with brand teams.
